scope.method: Read-only Rust/Python source and test inspection, retained report/log parsing, exact SHA-256 snapshots, in-memory AST-selected marker/policy probes only. No builds, Cargo/test binaries, QEMU, source edits, documentation changes, staging or commits.
limitations: This is not a full allocator, boot-memory, filesystem, capability or safe-API audit.
Saved guest reports predate this review and do not contain a complete source-hash freeze; current source hashes are review identities, not retroactive provenance for binaries.

prior_findings.resolution: mount_system_inner calls prepare_system through an ordinary exclusive reborrow. Shared-borrow preflight returns owned bindings and mountpoint; prepare_system resets the unpublished ArchiveFs on every error before the static borrow can be published. Success performs only infallible binding/point/archive publication. No second raw static archive alias or destruction under frame/VGA guards is introduced.
prior_findings.tests_inspected: Collision file, nonempty directory, RAM node exhaustion, overlong canonical prefix, Busy with existing system, post-point failure on owned/preexisting empty directory all verify empty snapshot capacities and preserved RAM namespace/bindings/system_point/cwd/duplicated descriptors. Exact path boundary success/refusal is covered separately.
prior_findings.saved_evidence: Four ELF rollback reports (collision/failure at 128/512 MiB) have PASS, cleanup true and snapshot-release followed by the exact rejection marker. The kernel checks restored used/live counts before that marker. These probes do not exercise the complete recovery shell.

prior_findings.resolution: Per-case CASE_OUTCOMES use exact complete lines and an exact relevant-outcome sequence, with ordered boot markers. Publication failures must reach their precise rejection class and release/OOM marker. Any trusted marker in a negative transcript is rejected. Invalid inventory alone requires the closed storage gate and forbids device discovery/mount. Recovery checks /system absent, except collision requires the sentinel file unchanged, before and after RAMFS recovery.

probe_result.method: In-memory AST-selected current marker functions; no module main/import side effects or files created. Positive transcript rows here were generated from CASE_OUTCOMES, so acceptance of positives alone is not an independent wire specification; separate source tests define literal expected transcripts.

prior_findings.qualification: This closes the false-positive implementation, not execution of the complete guest matrix. Existing code intentionally authenticates before parsing, so malformed/truncated bytes correctly reject as DigestMismatch; they do not prove parser-stage rejection of a separately trusted malformed image.

prior_findings.resolution: Vfs has a default None system_info query; MountedFs forwards the generic query to separate archive stats plus system_bindings bytes. Generic mem dispatch prints nodes, logical bytes, payload capacity and archive/routing metadata without altering RAMFS quotas. The host generic-trait test verifies the same accounting route and unchanged RAM stats. Both real-GRUB shell reports show nodes=4, logical/payload=59 bytes and metadata=5840 bytes.
prior_findings.remaining_requirement: Original request also asked for peak boot-import accounting including input copy and two simultaneously live parser indexes. Current shell/harness counters are live/final values, not peak. resource_sections.json explicitly leaves peak_heap_bytes and peak_stack_bytes null. Keep this part open for full resource/acceptance claims; do not present steady-state System counters or restored used/live counts as measured peak or proof of exact allocator free-span restoration.

prior_findings.resolution: Both verifier and ISO entrypoint/direct build reject INITRAMFS_TEST_MODE and fatal-fault text in exact artifact bytes. build_iso stages the same captured kernel_bytes it checked, rather than rereading a potentially changed file. Ten host-only source tests include stale fixture with production metadata, direct/entrypoint packager rejection, and checked-byte staging under a mocked source change.
prior_findings.probe_result: Current production ELF and previously extracted GRUB kernel both hash 7398cbb78124f7e9099b0af2cab94fa8be4c813276bcbab571c30e6d60609273 and have neither forbidden marker; current fixture ELF hashes 31f7d0b001a093eaab58481f507fb7d16c125d0504c5e78dfea96bc59cc32304 and contains INITRAMFS_TEST_MODE. AST-selected byte-policy probes accepted ordinary bytes and rejected both forbidden markers. This is not ELF contract validation or adversarial binary attestation.

oom_helper_review.result: Fixed static Vec metadata avoids large boot-stack arrays. Three bounded fallible reservation tiers pressure the actual allocator, then invoke the real try_build. All pressure Vecs drop before formatting/recovery; success marker requires actual OutOfMemory, increased failed_allocs and identical before/after used and live_allocs. No synthetic fail-reserve substitution or held frame/VGA guard is present.
oom_helper_review.evidence: rollback_resource-exhaustion_128 and _512 retain the recovered-OOM and publication-OutOfMemory sequence with cleanup true; real_oom_red is retained as FAIL and must not be counted as a pass.
oom_helper_review.limits: Not exhaustive reserve-point fault injection. Permanent growth mappings/capacity may increase even when pressure releases; equality of used/live is not proof of identical free-list topology, allocator headers, largest block or peak usage.

strict_matrix_storage_hash_cleanup_revie.result: Each scenario except deliberate missing-storage creates a fresh exclusive MAGIC-plus-zero corrupt owned image; media are not reused across refusal cases. Shared runner hashes the whole image before exercise and after independently reaping the captured Popen, and fails changed/unreadable media or incomplete checks. Phase10 additionally fails close/fallback/RSP errors. Acceptance validates exact unique identities, declared counts, invocation-owned nested reports and cleanup, rather than trusting process exit alone.
strict_matrix_storage_hash_cleanup_revie.host_tests_inspected: Final harness contracts cover wrong absent/error/order/gate/late publication, release/OOM markers, collision sentinel, fresh full-image hashes and deliberate mutation, close failure fallback, RSP cleanup failure, final/bootstrap heap diagnostics and nested 56-row report integration with 52 distinct disposable media. This review did not execute that complete unittest module.
limits: Cleanup here means owned emulator exit, not deletion of retained evidence/media.
The corrupt-media gate is not a valid mounted RostiFS persistence/coexistence test. Rejection scenarios do not uniformly assert the RostiFS rejection message or exercise raw-write policy commands.
ISO matrix boots real GRUB but injects the module descriptor at _start; separate retained real-GRUB module-directive positives establish that distinct producer path.
Current reboot-after-failure tests digest rejection followed by native no-module boot, not reboot after a partially constructed/publication failure.
Full recovery OOM workload and module-pin/growth checks are not repeated in every refusal class.

simultaneously_live_components: inventory-established physical module frames pinned until reboot (not heap and not reclaimable)
old archive snapshot if using replacement API (boot static starts empty)
staged new node capacity and payload capacity
allocator headers/alignment/fragmentation and caller stack headroom
resource_import_peak_model.publication_stage: After try_build returns the reparse index has dropped; the input copy and verification index still survive until the outer scope ends. The mount preflight uses bounded stack path/binding staging. Never sum only final System payload/metadata and call it import high-water.
